observations.title: Getty Museum Announces Acquisition of Ancient Greek Vase
observations.page_title: Getty Museum Announces Acquisition of Ancient Greek Vase - GreekReporter.com
observations.page_description: Today Timothy Potts, director of the J. Paul Getty Museum in Los Angeles, enthusiastically announced the museum’s acquisition of a Geometric Greek vase dating back to 720 to 700 BC. The addition of the Geometric Greek vase will be on display at the Getty Villa following its reinstallation in 2018. Standing at 27.5 inches, the […]
